title: Preparation and Properties of a Huge, Crystalline, and Water-Soluble Compound (C72H132N12Br6S12) That Possesses Six Carbenium Salt Units
abstract: Abstract                The reaction of hexakis(bromomethyl)benzene with six molar amounts of 2,2-bis(diethylamino)-2-ethylium-1-dithiocarboxylate furnished a huge, crystalline, and water-soluble compound (C72H132N12Br6S12, MW = 2030) that possesses six carbenium bromide units.
